name: Firework
tagline: Chrome and crimson, bright and gone before you've understood it.

facts.note: Verified by Trick after roughly 234,000 attempts. Rated the same day as Slaughterhouse and arcturus, it held #1 on the Demonlist for about 18 seconds — the shortest reign in the list's history — before Slaughterhouse passed it. Its difficulty rests almost entirely on tight timings rather than raw speed.

spotlight.sub: The shortest reign in the history of the Demonlist. Slaughterhouse was rated the same day and took it straight back.

voice.why:
Firework is a hauntingly beautiful, rhythmic nightmare. It was locked in a legendary battle with Slaughterhouse for the Top 1 spot. Instead of typical extreme demon colours, Firework utilises a stunning, monochromatic greyscale aesthetic that makes it feel like an old, melancholic silent film.

The gameplay is obscenely difficult, packed with terrifyingly precise cube timings and straight-fly sections that demand absolute perfection. Trick's verification of this level solidified it as an elegant, brutally difficult masterpiece.
